svg.aria-label: The research mode of the researcher skill. Boxes: Frame: the research questions, the baseline, the metric, the limits, the cluster's facts and the setting (stop); Frame: the dataset, from candidates with their size, licence and fit to the limits (stop); Builder: one piece of code from the session's brief, with its small local test (agent); Reviewer: the code against the brief, the test again, what makes a result false (agent); A piece of code that does not pass its review (stop); Baseline: its jobs through the scheduler, under the conditions of Frame (script); Experiments: each campaign's jobs through the scheduler (script); Compare: each result against the baseline, a diagnosis and a proposal for each that does not beat it (question); A result that does not beat the baseline, under the manual setting (stop); A result short of what was set, in research: it beats the baseline, under the manual setting (stop); idea, reopened with the diagnosis: the rounds of the interview (stop); Consolidate: run_all.sh once in a clean copy through the scheduler, each number compared, the record written (script); A number that does not reproduce (stop); A project underway: research adopt offered (stop); The jobs submitted: the job ids in the README, and the run stops (stop); A job that fails: its log and its script (stop); The count of methods reached with no result that beats the baseline, under the automatic setting (stop).

svg.text: The session writes each brief, starts each builder and each reviewer, submits the jobs and writes the README before each stage ends, so that a new session resumes from the README alone. Every job on a cluster runs from a script in code/hpc/, the small local test as a short job, and the session polls only when you ask. research adopt reads a project underway against each stage, writes the README

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sections it lacks, moves nothing and goes on from the first stage not done. full runs idea, shows the modes it will run and leaves out for you to confirm, then runs research or research adopt and manuscript, and goes on to manuscript on a partial result, or one below what was set, only on your word.
